patriae

questions.question: According to the excerpt, which of the following is part of patriotism in a democratic system?
options: Devoting time, ability, knowledge and even life for fundamental principles
Submitting to all traditional leaders without question
Avoiding civic duties to preserve personal freedom
Prioritizing private interests over the constitution
questions.answer: Devoting time, ability, knowledge and even life for fundamental principles
questions.explanation: The excerpt states that in a democratic system patriotism means devoting time, ability, knowledge and even life for the fundamental principles on which the nation’s security and welfare depend.

questions.question: Constitutional patriotism, as described in the text, most directly emphasizes:

Celebration of ethnic particularism without regard for rights
Avoiding all forms of political participation
Exclusive loyalty to historical symbols only

Alignment with democratic principles
Focus on protecting environmental resources only
